morphology.pattern_note: 整词借入；kh 通常表示 /x/，不应拆成马来语词缀。派生形式 mengkhuatiri、mengkhuatirkan 保留 kh。

senses.zh_definition: 因想到可能发生的不利情况而感到担心、忧虑或心神不安。
senses.en_definition: To feel worried or apprehensive about something that may happen.
senses.ms_definition: Berasa bimbang atau gelisah kerana memikirkan kemungkinan berlakunya sesuatu yang tidak diingini.
senses.nuances: 表示忧虑心理，未必达到惊恐程度。DBP 词库将其列为 kata kerja；中文和英文常用形容词表达相同状态。可接 akan、tentang 或以 kalau-kalau 引出担忧内容。这里的马来语释义依据词典改写。[DBP：khuatir](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=khuatir+)

dual_scenarios.context: 新闻 / 社区安全汇报
dual_scenarios.ms: Penduduk khuatir akan keselamatan anak-anak mereka berikutan peningkatan jumlah kenderaan berat di kawasan perumahan itu.
dual_scenarios.zh: 由于该住宅区的重型车辆增多，居民担心孩子们的安全。
dual_scenarios.en: Residents are concerned about their children's safety following an increase in heavy vehicles in the residential area.

dual_scenarios.ms_spoken: Jangan khuatir lah, aku dah sampai kat rumah.
dual_scenarios.ms_standard: Jangan khuatir, saya sudah sampai di rumah.
dual_scenarios.zh: 别担心啦，我已经到家了。
spoken_features: lah 在此缓和安慰语气。
dah 是 sudah 的口语缩略形式。
kat 在此对应标准语 di。
aku 适合熟悉的朋友之间使用。

messages.speaker: Farah (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Aku khuatir lah, kau tak balas mesej dari tadi. Dah sampai ke?
messages.ms_standard: Saya khuatir kerana awak tidak membalas mesej sejak tadi. Adakah awak sudah sampai?
messages.zh: 我都担心了，你刚才一直没回消息。到了吗？
messages.en: I was getting worried—you hadn't replied for a while. Have you arrived?

messages.speaker: Amir (朋友)
messages.ms_spoken: Dah, aku kat rumah dah. Bateri telefon habis tadi, jangan khuatir.
messages.ms_standard: Ya, saya sudah berada di rumah. Bateri telefon saya kehabisan kuasa tadi. Jangan khuatir.
messages.zh: 到了，我已经在家了。刚才手机没电了，别担心。
messages.en: Yes, I'm home now. My phone ran out of battery earlier. Don't worry.

etymology.historical_story: DBP identifies khuatir as an Arabic loanword. Its spelling preserves kh, a useful reminder of that connection. In Malay, the borrowed word belongs to the intimate language of concern: waiting for someone to return, fearing an accident, or anticipating trouble. Its derivatives distinguish feeling concern from causing it. [DBP](https://prpm.dbp.gov.my/Cari1?d=175768&keyword=khuatir+)
etymology.cognitive_memory_aid: 把 khuatir 联想成心里一直“挂着”的事：人还没回来，心就放不下。此为记忆联想，并非词源。

cultural_pragmatics.politeness_note: Saya khuatir… 可委婉引出顾虑，适合向同事或上级表达担心；说明具体原因会比直接否定更得体。
cultural_pragmatics.usage_etiquette: Jangan khuatir 适合安慰，但对方确有困难时，最好补充行动或信息，例如说明已经安全到家。朋友间也常用 risau 表达担心。
